summary: Capstone Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a first amendment to a senior secured convertible note originally issued July 29, 2025 to an institutional investor. The amendment extends the maturity date of the July 2025 Convertible Note from July 29, 2026 to August 29, 2026. The note had an original principal amount of approximately $3.27 million (or $3.55 million per the exhibit) with an 8.34% original issue discount. This is a routine debt modification, not a special situation; no change in ownership, control, or strategic direction is indicated. Watch whether further extensions signal liquidity pressure.
